preconditions.condition: Pad wrapper is located inside the zip bag.
preconditions.source_reference: Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag

review_notes: Visual confirmation of closure status is required to verify the seal.
Washing hands (A1, A8), glove properties (clean/sterile), wound inspection (red/swollen/leaking), and pad properties (non-stick) are excluded from the single-image rubric per scope constraints.
